name: Blank verse
note: Unrhymed iambic pentameter, no fixed length. The whole discipline is the line: it has to be a unit of sense as well as of measure, and when you break the meter it has to be because something happened.
ground: Surrey again, translating the Aeneid, and then two centuries of English drama built on it because it is the closest metrical form to how English is actually stressed.
ask: Which lines break the meter, and can you say what each break is for?
